dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, look at this bag! I really want it.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈlʊk ət ðɪs ˈbæɡ! aɪ ˈriːli ˈwɑːnt ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Let me see… Ten thousand baht? For a school bag?
dialogue.reading: ˈlɛt miː ˈsiː… ˈtɛn ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt? fər ə ˈskuːl ˈbæɡ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: It's from a famous brand. Everyone at school wants one.
dialogue.reading: ɪts frəm ə ˈfeɪməs ˈbrænd. ˈɛvriwʌn ət ˈskuːl ˈwɑːnts ˈwʌn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Despite the price, it doesn't look high-quality. It's just plastic with a big logo.
dialogue.reading: dɪˈspaɪt ðə ˈpraɪs, ɪt ˈdʌzənt ˈlʊk ˌhaɪ ˈkwɑːləti. ɪts ˈdʒʌst ˈplæstɪk wɪð ə ˈbɪɡ ˈloʊɡoʊ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: But people see the logo and know it's expensive!
dialogue.reading: bʌt ˈpiːpəl ˈsiː ðə ˈloʊɡoʊ ənd ˈnoʊ ɪts ɪkˈspɛnsɪv!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: So you'd pay ten thousand baht for a logo?
dialogue.reading: soʊ juːd ˈpeɪ ˈtɛn ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt fər ə ˈloʊɡoʊ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Well, despite being expensive, it's very popular.
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛl, dɪˈspaɪt ˈbiːɪŋ ɪkˈspɛnsɪv, ɪts ˈvɛri ˈpɑːpjələr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Smart consumers don't follow trends. They look for good quality.
dialogue.reading: ˈsmɑːrt kənˈsuːmərz ˈdoʊnt ˈfɑːloʊ ˈtrɛndz. ðeɪ ˈlʊk fər ˈɡʊd ˈkwɑːləti.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: In spite of what you say, I still want it.
dialogue.reading: ɪn ˈspaɪt əv ˈwʌt juː ˈseɪ, aɪ ˈstɪl ˈwɑːnt ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. Then save your own money for it!
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ˈðɛn ˈseɪv jʊr ˈoʊn ˈmʌni fər ɪt!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Ten thousand baht? That will take me a year!
dialogue.reading: ˈtɛn ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt? ðæt wɪl ˈteɪk miː ə ˈjɪr!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's right. Maybe by then you won't want it any more.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈraɪt. ˈmeɪbi baɪ ˈðɛn juː ˈwoʊnt ˈwɑːnt ɪt ˈɛni ˈmɔːr.
